clauses.summary: 台灣電力公司 營業規章施行細則 修正沿革
clauses.reason: title and amendment history, which ends at 108/9/17
the article the 施行細則 is made under
a rule on registering one's own generator

clauses.summary: 合格汽電共生系統之餘電及再生能源發電設備之電能，得由本公司收購
clauses.reason: Taipower buys surplus power from 汽電共生 and 再生能源 at their own rates; that pays the generator and is not this bill

clauses.summary: 線路設置費及複驗費單價均內含5%營業稅，免計營業稅用戶除以1.05
clauses.reason: VAT on 線路設置費 and 複驗費, which are not part of the electricity bill; the bill's VAT is 第三十九條
